instruction: Crisp studio photograph, full shot from a high angle in a minimalist white studio. On the left, the dancer in the black hooded outfit (R1) is bent forward with their head tucked down. On the right, the dancer in the white hooded outfit (R2) leans over R1 with both arms raised high. The two dancers are closely positioned, with R2 leaning dynamically over the hunched R1 as they perform a coordinated movement. Bright, even studio lighting casts soft shadows on the clean white floor.
